description: The workspace's brand report for a week (Monday to Sunday) or a month, in its timezone: posts and views against the period before, followers, reach, profile views and link-in-bio taps, the top posts, each series' episodes, taps on the workspace's links, and up to five plain summary lines to pass on. Default: last full week. report_link_create shares it with someone outside the team. delivery is the email for the client (to, subject, a sentence from the numbers, and once the period's link is made its url, body and mailto); report_email_create makes the link.

starts_on.description: Any day in the period (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: the last full week or month

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: report_get
title: Brand report
